Question Choices: Fill: An isosceles triangle has equal sides of 10 cm and a base of 16 cm. Find its area in cm squared.
Hints: Find height using a right triangle with half the base (8), then use the area formula
Solution: Half the base is 8. $h^2 + 8^2 = 10^2 \to h^2 + 64 = 100 \to h^2 = 36 \to h = 6$. Area $= 1/2 \cdot 16 \cdot 6 = 48$.
